description: Lightweight Bitwarden server API implementation written in Rust.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created on delete-data. Evidence: docs/evidence/vaultwarden-qualification.json. Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine and one architecture only.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Stores password vaults. Losing this app's folder loses the vaults with it, and there is no recovery — keep your own backup of that folder.
